## Flagship Projects & Verified Metrics

### 1. PLV eLib (CEIT Library) + AI Sidecar
- **Role**: Forward-Deployed Engineer, Technical Lead, and Solutions Architect
- **Architecture**: Decoupled dual-engine topology — Laravel 11 monolith (PHP 8.4, PostgreSQL, Livewire 3) paired with an external FastAPI AI Sidecar.
- **AI/RAG Pipeline**: SQLite FTS5 (BM25) + all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dense embeddings fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF, k=60) with deterministic blend re-ranking.
- **Metrics & Telemetry**:
  - Lifted Top-1 retrieval accuracy from 81.8% to 86.4% on a 27-case golden evaluation dataset.
  - 100% negative query pass rate (zero hallucination on out-of-domain queries).
  - 90% relevance score evaluated by automated LLM-as-judge (llama-3.3-70b).
  - Prometheus `/metrics` latency histograms and 6-chart Dockerized Grafana telemetry dashboard.
  - 600+ PHPUnit tests and 78 pytest tests.
- **Repositories**: https://github.com/PSergio984/CEIT-Library and https://github.com/PSergio984/ceit-ai-sidecar

### 2. AGOS — AI-Guided Overflow Surveillance
- **Role**: Technical Lead
- **Architecture**: Solar-powered edge IoT flood surveillance unit (Raspberry Pi Zero 2W + IR-Cut camera + JSN-SR04T waterproof ultrasonic sensor + 4G LTE) for Barangay Maysan, Valenzuela City.
- **AI & Optimization**:
  - Decoupled cadence: 15s web camera stream for human monitoring decoupled from 3-minute server-side YOLOv8 inference, slashing server compute by ~92%.
  - Decision Fusion Engine: Composite hazard score (water level <= 50pts, blockage <= 30pts, weather API <= 20pts) driving 3-tier physical alert LEDs and push/SMS notifications with 30-minute cooldown.
  - Dataset: 5,000 annotated drainage frames on CVAT.ai with OpenCV frame-quality pre-filtering.

### 3. Task-Buddy — AI-Assisted Task Management & RAG Memory
- **Role**: Technical Lead and Sole Developer
- **Stack**: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind v4, FastAPI, PostgreSQL (Supabase), pgvector, Redis.
- **AI/RAG Pipeline**:
  - Hybrid BM25 + Jina embeddings (jina-embeddings-v3) with RRF.
  - Sub-500ms task breakdown planning via Groq llama-3.3-70b with OpenAI fallback.
  - Contextual effort estimation derived from completion history.
  - 347 pytest backend tests, 338 KB minified frontend bundle, real-time WebSocket sync.

### 4. Compliant Customer Satisfaction Survey System
- **Role**: Sole Developer
- **Stack**: Laravel 12, Inertia.js 2, React 19, Filament 4, Spatie RBAC.
- **Security & Integrity**:
  - Custom `PiiScrubberProcessor` recursively redacting sensitive PII from application logs.
  - Synchronous `AnswerObserver` triggering immediate alerts for low ratings (<3 on 5-point scale).
  - 146 automated tests with 5,856 assertions.

## Digital Eric Conversational Agent
Eric's portfolio features **Digital Eric**, a first-person AI double deployed directly on the site. Digital Eric answers visitor and recruiter questions conversationally using a bounded knowledge file covering his verified background, war stories, certifications, and explicit refusal boundaries for unknown queries.
